lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hf4Ga4C8 (reduced formula HfGaC2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Ga in a tetrahedral environment of four C neighbors at 2.109 Å, C with two Ga neighbors at the same distance, and Hf with eight C neighbors at 2.6832 Å. Polyhedron-sharing relations show edge-sharing between Ga tetrahedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Hf and Ga polyhedra, giving a three-dimensional connected network.
